scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Girl Child Protection Scheme-II
other_conditions: Only two girl children per family are eligible
One parent must have undergone sterilization before turning 40 years old
Family must have only one female child and no male child, and no male child may be adopted in the future
Parents/grandparents must be native of Tamil Nadu by birth or have continuous residence of at least ten years at the time of applying
Scheme also applies to girl children of Sri Lankan Tamil refugees residing in Tamil Nadu refugee camps
Application must be submitted before the second child reaches 3 years of age
Matured amount will be given to the girl child only if she appears for the 10th standard public exam
benefits_summary: Each eligible girl receives a fixed deposit of ₹25,000, renewable after five years, with an annual incentive of ₹1,800 from the sixth year, payable at age 18 upon appearing for the 10th standard exam.
